title: Restart
author: Maxx M.
desc: 2 month program for weight loss, back strengthening exercises and full body work to get you back into shape

ex.note: Go at whatever speed feels comfortable this is purely to get blood flowing through your body
The barbell without weight is 45 pounds, if you can not add any plates right away that’s okay but mark your weight lifted as 45. Focus on feeling it in your butt, hamstrings and lower back.
Focus on good form, and the stretch of the exercise more than the weight starting out
You should only really feel this between your shoulder blades and your lats, if you’re feeling it elsewhere take a moment to check form
